method: Read original saved rollout/observation/material arrays and event records; arithmetic only. No physics, optimizer, constitutive or neural-network recomputation.

a.normalization: Fixed engineering normalization from PolicyMaterial.observation; GaussianActor.forward passes this vector directly into Linear/Tanh, without running mean/variance normalization or clipping. No activation/weight inference is made.

b.normalization: Fixed engineering normalization from PolicyMaterial.observation; GaussianActor.forward passes this vector directly into Linear/Tanh, without running mean/variance normalization or clipping. No activation/weight inference is made.

zero_pann_with_truth_overlap_original_pu.interpretation: At the earlier 2ms observation, the sole had not yet covered the queried virgin x-column; at the later observation, the foot bottom was already above the undeformed surface. Truth-only loading occurred between these observations. No constitutive or network rerun is needed to explain zero PANN for these keys.
